```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```


#read in motion data
```{r}
files = list.files(path = "../fmriprep_confounds", pattern = ".*desc-confounds.*\\.tsv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

          
comb_df = files %>% 
    map_dfr(read_tsv, col_types = cols(framewise_displacement = col_number()), .id = "source")

comb_df = mutate(comb_df, 
                 filename = files[as.numeric(source)])

comb_df = comb_df %>%
  mutate(subid = gsub('../fmriprep_confounds/', '', filename),
         subid = gsub("/.*", "", subid))

comb_df = comb_df %>%
  mutate(sesid = gsub('../fmriprep_confounds/sub-[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9]/', '', filename),
        sesid = gsub("/.*", "", sesid))
```

#descriptive stats
```{r}
quantile(comb_df$framewise_displacement, na.rm=TRUE)
IQR(comb_df$framewise_displacement, na.rm=TRUE)

quantile(comb_df$std_dvars, na.rm=TRUE)
IQR(comb_df$std_dvars, na.rm=TRUE)

#median per P
median <- comb_df %>%
  group_by(subid, sesid) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(median = median(framewise_displacement, na.rm=TRUE))

mean <- comb_df %>%
  group_by(subid, sesid) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(framewise_displacement, na.rm=TRUE))

write.csv(file='../data/mean_motion.csv',mean)



#get %age above .5
comb_df$framewise_displacement <- ifelse(is.na(comb_df$framewise_displacement),0,comb_df$framewise_displacement)
x=1:nrow(comb_df)
comb_df$outlier <- NA
for (i in x) {
  if(comb_df$framewise_displacement[i] > 0.5) {
      comb_df$outlier[i]=1
  } else {
  comb_df$outlier[i]=0
}
}

outlier_count <- comb_df %>%
  group_by(subid,sesid) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(count = sum(outlier))

outlier_count$percent <- outlier_count$count/180
```
